title: Основные инфекции собак
terminology: Пакет содержит четыре конкретных заболевания и один регулируемый public-health маршрут, а не универсальную карточку вирусной инфекции.
Clinical pattern и vaccination history формируют вероятность, но не подтверждают и не исключают заболевание сами по себе.
До попадания в общую очередь заразный пациент получает infection-control triage, isolation/PPE flow и exposure log.
Отрицательный rapid test не стирает seeded infectious truth после reload; timing, dilution, shedding и sample site сохраняются.
Положительный PCR или serology не автоматически доказывает активную причинную инфекцию без клинического и sample context.
Recent vaccination может осложнять интерпретацию отдельных тестов и всегда сохраняется с product/date/age-series identity.
Парвовирусная тяжесть определяется гидратацией, perfusion, leukopenia, glucose, sepsis и organ status, а не только antigen result.
Distemper может иметь delayed/progressive neurologic phase без одновременных respiratory signs.
Canine adenovirus hepatic pattern требует coagulation/function safety и исключения hepatic mimics.
Leptospirosis возможен у любого signalment/lifestyle, имеет kidney/liver/respiratory patterns и zoonotic urine/blood barrier route.
MAT не считается надёжным определителем infecting serovar; blood/urine PCR, acute/convalescent MAT и vaccination context интерпретируются вместе.
Suspected rabies никогда не является обычным exam-room case: local law и public-health authority определяют handling, testing/observation и disposition.
Система не генерирует drug, dose, fluid, antimicrobial, isolation duration, vaccine schedule или legal/regulatory disposition.

commonHistoryQuestions.prompt: Каковы origin, shelter, travel, wildlife/water и contact dates?
Каковы vaccine product, dates, age series и recent vaccination?
Каков onset и порядок fever, GI, respiratory, ocular и neurologic signs?
Какие household animals и shared spaces были exposed?
Каковы vomiting, diarrhea, intake, urine и hydration?
Есть ли behavior/swallowing/salivation/paralysis changes или bite history?
Есть ли kidney, liver, bleeding, respiratory или neurologic red flags?
Каковы sample type/site/time/storage и pretest treatment?
Каковы prior antigen/PCR/serology/MAT и laboratory identity?
Кто контактировал с urine, blood, saliva или bite?
Каковы isolation, PPE, decontamination и room capacity?
Возможны ли referral, public-health contact и recheck?

variants.title: Парвовирусный энтерит собак
variants.diagnosticTruth: Compatible acute GI disease, exposure/vaccine context, fecal antigen with timing limits and PCR/repeat review establish parvovirus evidence; severe leukopenia, dehydration and sepsis drive urgency.

presentations.complaint: A young incompletely vaccinated dog has acute vomiting, diarrhea and exposure risk.

outcomes.safe: Isolation and testing preserve uncertainty correctly.

ownerCommunication: Explain isolation immediately and why vaccine history changes risk but does not answer the test question.

presentations.complaint: A compatible case has a negative fecal antigen at a timing or dilution point that may reduce sensitivity.

followUp.timing: prompt repeat/PCR and serial clinical status

outcomes.safe: Discordance is resolved without regenerating truth.
outcomes.unsafe: One negative closes isolation and diagnosis.

ownerCommunication: Explain that timing and stool dilution can make a rapid test negative despite compatible disease.

presentations.complaint: Parvovirus-compatible disease includes severe leukopenia, dehydration, sepsis risk or exposed household dogs.

examFindings.finding: Rapid test is not the only decision.

followUp.timing: continuous severity and household exposure tracking

outcomes.safe: Critical care and outbreak logic remain linked.
outcomes.unsafe: No room capacity leads to routine waiting or no referral.

ownerCommunication: Explain both the immediate severity and the separate household/environment exposure obligations.

variants.title: Чума плотоядных: multisystemic disease
variants.diagnosticTruth: Distemper suspicion integrates respiratory, GI, ocular, dermatologic and neurologic chronology with multisite testing and vaccine context; delayed neurologic disease may occur without active respiratory signs.

presentations.complaint: Fever, respiratory/GI signs and ocular disease form a multisystem distemper pattern.

outcomes.safe: Multisite evidence and course determine diagnosis.

ownerCommunication: Explain why several body systems and sample sites matter for this infection.

presentations.complaint: Neurologic disease appears after earlier systemic illness or progresses without current respiratory signs.

outcomes.safe: Delayed neurologic phase remains linked to prior disease.

ownerCommunication: Explain that neurologic signs can appear after respiratory/GI signs have faded.

presentations.complaint: Recent vaccination, sample site or concurrent infection makes a distemper result hard to interpret.

followUp.timing: after lab interpretation and clinical course

outcomes.unsafe: Any PCR signal is active causal distemper.

ownerCommunication: Explain why recent vaccine and where the sample came from can change interpretation.

variants.title: Инфекционный гепатит собак (adenovirus)
variants.diagnosticTruth: Fever, abdominal pain, hepatic injury, bleeding and acute failure create an adenovirus differential, but liver enzymes and vaccination do not replace coagulation/function assessment, hepatic mimic review and specific confirmation.

presentations.complaint: Fever, abdominal pain and hepatic injury form a possible adenoviral pattern.

followUp.timing: serial liver function/coagulation and lab confirmation

outcomes.safe: Hepatic risk and etiology stay separate.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the liver pattern is serious but several diseases can cause it and specific confirmation is needed.

presentations.complaint: Suspected infectious hepatitis includes coagulopathy, acute liver failure or peracute collapse.

outcomes.safe: Critical liver failure is routed immediately.

ownerCommunication: Explain that failure and bleeding are emergencies regardless of final infectious cause.

presentations.complaint: A hepatic syndrome could be adenovirus, leptospirosis, toxin or another hepatobiliary disease.

outcomes.unsafe: Hepatic injury is renamed infectious hepatitis.

ownerCommunication: Explain that several urgent diseases share the same liver pattern and require different confirmation routes.

variants.title: Лептоспироз собак: zoonotic route
variants.diagnosticTruth: Leptospirosis can affect any dog and requires zoonotic barriers, organ-pattern assessment and timed blood/urine PCR plus acute/convalescent MAT interpreted with vaccination; serovar and active causality are not read from one titer.

presentations.complaint: Acute kidney, liver or respiratory disease occurs in a dog of any lifestyle or signalment.

historyAnswers.origin_shelter_travel_wildlife_water_and: Water/rodent/environment context recorded but not required.

followUp.timing: continuous organ status and timed testing

outcomes.safe: Barriers and organ care begin before confirmation.
outcomes.unsafe: Indoor or small dog status excludes disease.

ownerCommunication: Explain the zoonotic urine/blood precautions and that any dog can be affected.

presentations.complaint: Blood/urine PCR and MAT results require timing, vaccination and convalescent-sample interpretation.

examFindings.finding: One titer cannot name infecting serovar reliably.

followUp.timing: acute and convalescent evidence with organ trend

outcomes.unsafe: Single MAT titer declares serovar and cause.

ownerCommunication: Explain why blood, urine and paired antibody samples answer different timing questions.

presentations.complaint: Suspected/confirmed leptospirosis requires urine/blood barriers and owner human-health guidance.

followUp.timing: through contagious/exposure window defined by reviewed protocol

outcomes.safe: Human exposure and animal care remain connected.
outcomes.unsafe: Zoonotic guidance is omitted or a duration is invented.

ownerCommunication: Give barrier instructions and direct exposed/symptomatic people to human healthcare without diagnosing them.

variants.title: Rabies exposure или подозреваемый случай
variants.diagnosticTruth: Rabies exposure or compatible unexplained neurologic disease requires no routine handling, immediate exposure documentation and public-health/veterinary-authority control under local law; the game cannot choose legal disposition.

presentations.complaint: A bite or wildlife contact raises a rabies question with uncertain vaccination documentation.
ownerCommunication: Avoid handling instructions beyond safety and state that public-health authority determines the next legal steps.

presentations.complaint: Unexplained behavior, swallowing, salivation, paralysis or neurologic signs create a rabies public-health concern.

examFindings.finding: Differential cannot be resolved by routine exam.

outcomes.safe: Staff exposure is prevented and authority notified.
outcomes.unsafe: A neurologic exam is attempted in routine space.

ownerCommunication: Keep distance, prevent further exposure and contact the designated authority immediately.

presentations.complaint: Human bite/saliva exposure requires public-health notification and a regulated animal disposition route.

outcomes.safe: Human and animal routes are documented and authority-led.
outcomes.unsafe: The game picks quarantine, testing or euthanasia.

ownerCommunication: Tell exposed people to contact human healthcare/public health immediately and avoid promising a specific animal disposition.

familyValidationRules: Reject if vaccination or breed alone proves or excludes disease.
Reject if one negative rapid test always excludes parvovirus or any positive PCR proves active causal disease without context.
Reject if distemper neurologic disease requires simultaneous respiratory signs.
Reject if leptospirosis is restricted to outdoor large dogs or MAT reliably names infecting serovar.
Reject if suspected rabies enters routine waiting-room flow or receives an invented legal disposition.
Reject if external results are instant.
Reject if code generates drug, dose, fluid, antimicrobial, isolation duration, vaccine or regulatory protocol.
